verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API that 'provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources' (unleash-docs-6). API tokens are explicitly intended for 'other tools and automation' (unleash-docs-23, unleash-docs-15), so the product can be driven programmatically. The AI-native angle is reinforced by an official MCP server for managing flags (unleash-docs-7, unleash-probe-2) and an llms.txt with agent instructions (unleash-probe-1). Missing for 10: endpoint-level reference detail or an OpenAPI spec in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
